## 1. One-paragraph verdict
The ledger itself is honest and internally correct: every one of its 28 entries
(6 valid + 22 malformed, all in the avi_mjpeg_pcm/mp4_mjpeg_pcm families)
matches the committed file byte-for-byte (my python3 sha256+size check: 28/28
OK, 0 mismatched, 0 missing). The problem is what it does NOT cover: the
generated/ tree on disk holds 116 files; 88 of them — the entire wav, aiff,
ogg, mkv/webm, mp4_h264, mp4_chapters, mp4_edts, mp4_frag, 3gp, mov, ivf and
non-mjpeg valid families — are absent from the manifest, so the advertised
drift gate is blind to 76% of the tree it is presented as governing.

## 2. What actually works (verified)
— python3 cross-check: for each of 28 entries, sha256(bytes) == manifest
sha256 AND size == size_bytes → 28/28 ok / 0 mismatch / 0 missing.
— Header (verbatim, L1-8): `# Generated by \`cargo xtask fixtures\` (card
2.A3) — DO NOT EDIT.` / `# Regenerate: cargo xtask fixtures. Drift gate:
cargo xtask fixtures --check.` / `seed_root = "lumen-2a3-v1"` /
`file_count = 28`.

## 3. Findings
F-001 [S3]
Where: tests/fixtures/generated/MANIFEST.toml:1-8 vs tree contents
Code:
# Generated by `cargo xtask fixtures` (card 2.A3) — DO NOT EDIT.
# Regenerate: cargo xtask fixtures. Drift gate: cargo xtask fixtures --check.
What is wrong: `file_count = 28` while `ls`/os.walk count 116 files under
tests/fixtures/generated/ (excluding MANIFEST.toml). The 88 uncovered files
include every malformed wav/aiff/ogg/webm/mkv derivative (consumed by
crates/demux/tests/*_fixtures.rs via format!-built paths) and the valid
parents those derivatives derive from. Consequences: (a) silent corruption or
accidental regeneration-drift of those files is undetectable by the
advertised `--check` gate; (b) the parents of the unmanifested malformed
files have no recorded sha256 anywhere in-repo (the consuming tests pin
behavior — terminal reasons, frame counts — not file digests; only
crates/demux/tests/ivf_fixtures.rs:92-112 pins payload MD5s), so "verified
this session" provenance in wav_aiff_fixtures.rs:39 is not reproducible from
the tree. Why it matters: fixture trust is the base layer of test honesty;
the gate's coverage is a quarter of what the header implies. What correct
looks like: extend the manifest schema to the remaining families or move the
gate's claim (which families are gated) into the header.
Confidence: HIGH — Verification: ran (python3 cross-check + os.walk).
